ai_overview.visible_text:
Experiencing persistent breakouts, burning, and severe irritation usually indicates a compromised skin barrier. When dealing with chronic inflammatory conditions like eczema or rosacea, using a potent prescription active like tretinoin can easily trigger retinoid dermatitis, resulting in an intense burning sensation and flares.
